text:
Matt Boldy is the shooter on the Wild's top line, and this month the points have poured in: 18 in his last ten games, 32 for the season in 26, with three-point nights stacking up. He has 104 shots, the most of anyone on his line, and his goals (14) match his expected goals (13.7) almost exactly. The finishing is honest.

The luck is around him. Minnesota has scored 12.0 more goals than the chances deserve with Boldy on the ice, and we'd have expected about 11 points from his last ten, not 18. Beside Kirill Kaprizov and Joel Eriksson Ek, on a team with points in 15 straight, the bounces have all gone one way. The process underneath is strong anyway: 57% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on, and he exits the zone with possession 70% of the time in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking. Our range says 83 to 109 points. Expect the pace to cool, not the player.
